howToPlay: Stay stationary to trigger your focused state, which increases your attack range. Use the Caramelize gadget to slow enemies or Cookie Crumbs to pierce through cover, and save your Super to snipe foes from long range.
gears: Equip Damage to boost your offensive output when health is low and Shield to increase your overall survivability.
trait: This brawler suits a precise player who prefers controlling the battlefield from a distance while standing still.
